Senior Data Scientist - Experimentation & Measurement
San Mateo, CA
Overview:
As a Senior Data Scientist on the Decision Science team within the Data Science, Analytics, & Enablement (DSAE) organization at PlayStation, you will take a leading role in designing and interpreting experiments that evaluate the impact of PS4 to PS5 user migration initiatives, growth marketing strategies, and broader campaign performance. This role is focused on advancing our experimentation practices—bringing statistical rigor, clear measurement strategies, and deep causal inference expertise to some of the most critical initiatives across PlayStation.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Lead the design, execution, and interpretation of A/B tests and quasi-experiments to evaluate the impact of user migration initiatives (PS4 to PS5), growth marketing strategies, and campaign performance.
Partner with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, marketing) to embed experimentation into development and iteration cycles.
Serve as a thought leader on best practices for hypothesis development, metric selection, test structure, and results communication.
Apply advanced causal inference methods when experimentation isn’t feasible or to inform test design and prioritization.
Help define and contribute to centralized experimentation frameworks, tools, and documentation to scale best practices across the company.
Independently extract, transform, and analyze data from complex systems using SQL, Python, and other analytics tools.
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping drive business decisions with rigor and clarity.
Stay current on new methodologies in experimentation and causal analysis, and bring fresh perspectives to the team’s work.
Basic Requirements:
Bachelor’s
degree or equivalent.
5+ years of experience in a data science experimentation-focused role (3+ with PhD).
Deep expertise in A/B testing and causal inference, including quasi-experimental methods.
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation.
Proficiency in Python, including statistical and data science libraries.
Broad and applied knowledge of statistical techniques and machine learning modeling methods.
Proven ability to influence product and business decisions through clear, actionable insights.
Experience contributing to or developing experimentation frameworks, best practices, or internal tooling.

Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Economics, or Econometrics. Other degrees in quantitative disciplines may be considered.

Design and implement foundation models end to end through the feature extraction to inference for embodied agents.
Define the long-term roadmap for Game AI and Embodied Intelligence, acting as a technical bar-raiser for code quality and architectural design.

Proficiency in Python (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and familiarity with C#, C++, or similar systems languages.
A passion for bridging the gap between research and production, moving beyond academic benchmarks to launch scalable solutions that directly impact millions of users.

jobs.description: Within AWS Marketing, the Data Science and Engineering (D:SE) team is the central data, science, and intelligence organization. We own the data foundation, the measurement and causal economics frameworks, the scoring and intelligence models, and the agentic AI systems that power marketing decisions across AWS. We exist because marketing at AWS scale requires more than dashboards and reports. It requires a unified data layer rich enough to train models on, composable enough for AI agents to reason over, and rigorous enough to hold investment decisions accountable. We build that layer and the intelligence products on top of it. We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help us build and scale our next-generation MLOps and agentic AI systems. You'll work with a serverless, AWS-native stack: - Agentic AI - AWS Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore (runtime, memory, tool gateway), Bedrock Guardrails, ReAct-style agent loops with model routing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that expose our data and retrieval tools to agents - ML platform - AWS SageMaker for training pipelines, Feature Store, and real-time inference endpoints; embedding pipelines; hybrid retrieval combining dense vector similarity and BM25; reranking; and LLM-as-judge evaluation harnesses - Compute and orchestration - AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, AWS EventBridge, and Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA) - Data and serving - AWS Redshift (via the Redshift Data API), AWS S3, AWS DynamoDB, and AWS OpenSearch Service - Infrastructure and operations - AWS CDK for all infrastructure, so every environment is reproducible and code-reviewed rather than clicked into a console; AWS CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and dashboards; CloudWatch RUM; SNS alerting; SQS dead-letter queues; and canary deployments promoted through beta, gamma, and production Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and operate production agentic AI systems - agent runtimes, MCP tool servers, retrieval pipelines, guardrails, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest - Own the retrieval and ranking quality loop end to end: hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval, graded relevance signals, reranking on live in-session data, and offline plus LLM-as-judge evaluation before parameters become contract - Productionize machine learning models with your applied science partners - training pipelines, feature engineering into SageMaker Feature Store, real-time inference behind low-latency APIs, and the deployment gates that make model rollout safe - Build and scale serverless data pipelines over datasets in the billions of rows, including ingestion connectors, transformation orchestration, and validated migrations with parallel-run and rollback strategies - Raise the operational bar on what you own: instrumentation, actionable alarms tuned against real SLOs, data-quality and freshness observability, runbooks, load and game-day testing, and participation in an on-call rotation - Write the design documents, drive the code reviews, and make the tradeoff calls - you'll own systems, not tickets - Work AI-natively. Our team uses agentic development tooling daily, and we expect you to extend it as well as use it A day in the life You might start by triaging an alarm on an agent's tool-call latency, then pair with an applied scientist on why a reranking signal isn't lifting conversion, then review a teammate's CDK change that adds a freshness alarm to an indexing pipeline. Afternoons tend toward deeper work: a design doc for replacing a mocked data source with a live pipeline, or an evaluation run that decides whether a model change ships. You'll spend meaningful time with product and data engineering partners, because most of our interesting problems are ambiguous before they're technical. About the team You'll join a tight, high-impact team of software engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, applied scientists, and product managers solving problems at the intersection of marketing analytics, data science enablement, and platform engineering. We're small enough that your work is visible and unambiguously yours, and we ship fast - recent agentic AI products have gone from concept to production in a handful of sprints. You'll experience a culture that values ownership, cross-functional collaboration, and data-driven decision making.

I vores organisation arbejder vi ud fra visionen om Science of Healthier Animals og en stærk tro på forebyggelse som fundamentet for både dyrevelfærd og produktivitet. Vores ambition er klar: Vi ønsker at levere løsninger, ikke blot produkter. Ved at kombinere videnskabelig indsigt, kommerciel forståelse og teknologiske muligheder stræber vi efter at være den foretrukne samarbejdspartner for danske grisedyrlæger og producenter. Den danske grisebranche står over for betydelige udfordringer og forandringer. Vi ønsker at spille en aktiv rolle i denne udvikling. Derfor søger vi nu en Customer Engagement Manager – Gris i Danmark. Det er en central markedsvendt rolle, hvor du opbygger stærke relationer baseret på tillid og omsætter indsigt til konkrete resultater. Som vores grisefaglige ekspert i marken bliver du en betroet samarbejdspartner for dyrlæger og producenter over hele landet. Du får stor indflydelse på kundeaktiviteter, strategiske initiativer og den fortsatte udvikling af vores forretning i Danmark. Din rolle Du får ansvar for aktiviteter inden for griseområdet i Danmark og arbejder tæt sammen med engagerede kolleger i det nordiske griseteam. Dine arbejdsdage bliver varierede og vil spænde fra dialog med dyrlæger og besætningsbesøg til mere strategisk planlægning og tværgående projekter. Du får en vigtig rolle i at hjælpe kunder med at navigere i en stadig mere kompleks branche ved at identificere muligheder, udfordre eksisterende tilgange og understøtte implementeringen af innovative og bæredygtige løsninger. Dine opgaver består i at: Opbygge og udvikle stærke samarbejder med danske grisedyrlæger og andre vigtige interessenter. Understøtte grisedyrlægernes arbejde i besætningerne ved hjælp af diagnostisk support og input til problemløsning. Uddanne og træne besætningsmedarbejdere i optimale vaccinationsrutiner. Omsætte videnskab og analyser til praktiske, værdiskabende løsninger. Deltage i relevante projektsamarbejder med grisedyrlæger og andre samarbejdspartnere. Samarbejde internt på tværs af funktioner med kolleger inden for Grise-, Livestock-, Marketing- og Technology Solutions-afdelingerne. Bidrage direkte til vores salgs- og aktivitetsmål samt være med til at forme vores langsigtede strategi for griseområdet i Danmark. Hvem er du? Du ønsker at kombinere veterinærfaglig ekspertise med en kommerciel og løsningsorienteret tilgang. Du trives i marken, nyder at opbygge relationer og motiveres af at omsætte indsigt til praktiske løsninger hos kunderne. Du er nysgerrig, omstillingsparat og drives af at hjælpe kunder med at lykkes i en branche under konstant udvikling. Vi forestiller os, at du har: Kandidatgrad i veterinærmedicin (dyrlæge). Flydende dansk- og engelsk-kundskaber i både skrift og tale. Godt kendskab til dansk griseproduktion. Praktisk erfaring fra grisebranchen, dyrlægepraksis, rådgivning eller en lignende kundeorienteret rolle. En kommerciel og samarbejdsorienteret tilgang samt motivation for at skabe forretningsmæssige resultater. En proaktiv og selvstændig arbejdsstil kombineret med en stærk holdånd. God videnskabelig forståelse og kendskab til relevante sygdomsområder. Højt personligt engagement, handlekraft og fokus på resultater. Stærke relationelle og kommunikative kompetencer. En struktureret og datadrevet tilgang samt evnen til at håndtere flere prioriteter samtidigt. Vi tilbyder En fuldtidsstilling med base i Danmark og hjemmekontor. 70-80 % af arbejdstiden ”i marken” i Danmark, med enkelte flerdags-rejser i Norden og Europa. Særdeles gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og fortsat læring indenfor vores fokusområder. Mulighed for at præge den fremtidige udvikling af vores arbejde med grisesundhed i Danmark. En stærk nordisk teamkultur baseret på tillid, åbenhed, videndeling og omtanke for hinanden. Et miljø, hvor idéer bliver værdsat, ekspertise anerkendt, og hvor ambitionen om at skabe værdi for kunderne driver vores udvikling. Muligheden for at gøre en reel forskel for dyrevelfærd, produktivitet og fremtiden for dansk griseproduktion. En attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer, inklusive pension, firmabil og hjemmekontorudstyr. Du bliver en del af et erfarent nordisk griseteam med stærke kompetencer inden for både videnskab, besætningsrådgivning og kommerciel udvikling. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem samarbejde, nysgerrighed og gensidig respekt. Klar til din næste udfordring? SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Are you a strategic thinker and proven problem-solver with deep expertise in modern IT ecosystems? We're seeking a
Sr. IT Systems Engineer
passionate about driving automation, maturing enterprise workforce identity and access management (IAM), and architecting scalable, secure SaaS integrations. This senior individual contributor role serves as a key technical resource, partnering closely with IT Services, Information Security, HR, Finance, and Engineering teams. You'll own the deployment and integration of mission-critical IT systems, act as the primary escalation point for complex IT outages and architectural challenges, and guide the evolution of our hybrid infrastructure to support rapid business growth.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of core SaaS platforms including Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and other IT tools.
Own end-to-end support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of applications, systems, and their complex interconnections—ensuring high availability, security, and seamless user experience.
Help architect and advance our workforce Identity and Access Management program, including configuration of Single Sign-On (SSO), lifecycle management, provisioning/deprovisioning, access governance, and policy enforcement.
Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) providing strategic technical guidance to support business expansion, system scalability, and infrastructure maturity.
Drive cross-functional knowledge sharing by authoring, maintaining, and evolving comprehensive IT documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams.
Proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities in the environment; lead initiatives to enhance security posture, operational efficiency, and resilience—prioritizing automation of manual/repetitive processes.
Evaluate emerging technologies, IAM trends, and automation platforms; develop business cases and lead proof-of-concepts or adoption recommendations.
Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with cross-functional teams to align IT capabilities with organizational goals.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
8+ years of hands-on experience administering and optimizing a broad portfolio of SaaS applications in a hybrid and high-growth environment—with advanced proficiency in our core stack: Okta (including Advanced Server Access & Workflows), Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise, Atlassian, etc.
4+ years of deep experience with n8n, Okta Workflows and/or other leading iPaaS/automation platforms (e.g., Workato, Zapier, BetterCloud, custom integrations).
Expert-level knowledge of IAM principles and protocols: SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, JIT provisioning, SWA, RBAC, ABAC, and access governance best practices.
Strong experience designing and working with APIs for custom integrations, data flows, and automation.
Proficiency in scripting and automation for monitoring, alerting, and operational efficiency (e.g., Google Apps Manager (GAM), Python, Bash, PowerShell, Terraform, or similar); experience building custom solutions is highly valued.
Solid working knowledge and administrative experience in Azure, AWS, and/or GCP cloud platforms.
Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proven track record of resolving sophisticated, cross-system incidents under pressure.
Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable business impact, own key deliverables, and drive projects to completion in fast-paced environments with competing priorities.
Comfortable adapting to dynamic requirements, handling time-sensitive escalations, and participating in on-call rotation.
Track record of success as a Senior IT Systems Engineer or equivalent in a fast-moving corporate or tech environment.
Okta certifications (e.g., Okta Certified Professional / Administrator / Consultant) strongly preferred; other relevant certifications (Google Workspace) are a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred (or equivalent demonstrated experience) is a plus.
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
$148,000 - $222,000 USD
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Initiate engineering deviation requests and product change notices, as appropriate, and provide quality input for sustaining engineering and product/process changes. Prepare and present quality performance, complex analyses, recurring issues, and recommended actions in regular operational and quality review meetings. Lead or participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on product quality, process discipline, flow, efficiency, and prevention of defects. Serve as the Quality representative on applicable new-product-development, sustaining-engineering, and cross-functional improvement teams. Demonstrated experience leading work, coordinating priorities, training others, or providing technical direction in a production or quality environment required; prior formal supervisory experience is helpful but not required. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distinguish immediate containment from true corrective and preventive action. jobs.description: Come be a part of Amazon's dynamic Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Production Operations Manager who brings both strategic business acumen and hands-on production expertise to own the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple live sports properties, from initial financial modeling and vendor strategy through boots-on-the-ground execution. In this role, you will serve as the centralized operational lead for your assigned properties, driving strategic planning across the full project lifecycle. You will lead financial modeling, shape vendor strategy, and manage engagement with third-party Production Service Partners (PSPs), coordinating backend functions including crewing, payroll, travel, and production accounting while maintaining Amazon's operational standards and ensuring productions launch on time and on budget. Equally critical is your ability to deliver on the ground. You will work in lockstep with internal crewing, editorial, and technical workstreams to ensure each event or studio show is properly resourced, and will partner directly with PSPs to establish best practices, define operational standards, and ensure alignment across the vendor landscape. You will drive production readiness across all operational workstreams, ensuring each event is prepared for a clean launch and seamless restart. This role requires deep knowledge of remote, event, and studio production operations, including broadcast positions, industry standard rates, vendor engagement models, and production service agreements. You will be responsible for issue spotting, driving decision making, and escalating matters that carry risk to the Global Head of Production Operations. Our production operation is purpose-built around the needs of an expanding, multi-sport live portfolio rather than modeled after a traditional broadcast network structure. We are defining and building as we evolve, and this person must be excited to roll up their sleeves and help establish the systems, relationships, and workflows that will scale with us. The successful candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You can juggle competing priorities across multiple productions with autonomy, react with urgency when situations demand immediate attention, and bring a proven track record of end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business. Key job responsibilities • End-to-End Property Lifecycle Management: Own and manage the full project lifecycle for assigned properties, from projected business scope and production roadmap development, through execution and ongoing supervision of day-to-day live event and studio production, to post-mortem and financial reconciliation. Develop milestones, launch schedules, and workback timelines to ensure successful delivery of property launches and season restarts. Lead property transition planning for returning seasons, ensuring operational continuity, vendor re-engagement, and incorporation of prior-season learnings into the restart roadmap. • Business Strategy and Vendor Management: Develop a deep understanding of organizational business objectives and production priorities to drive vendor evaluation, selection, and strategic recommendations that optimize cost, quality, and scalability across assigned properties. Shepherd the vendor selection process through RFPs and serve as the primary point of contact for vendors defining scope of work, deliverables, and engagement standards. Partner with Legal and Production Finance on contract terms, rate frameworks, and commercial agreements, and monitor vendor performance to ensure accountability against operational standards. • Budget and Financial Management: Create and manage production budgets from initial scoping through execution. Work closely with Production Finance to track and reconcile all production costs, ensuring external vendors and the production team are aware of overall spend. Coordinate fee reconciliation and payment processing with third-party vendors to ensure accuracy and timeliness. Lead regular financial status updates to senior leadership, flagging variances and recommending corrective action. • Crewing Coordination via PSPs: Ensure assigned properties are properly staffed by coordinating crew deployment through third-party vendors. Establish consistent frameworks for how Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) personnel are engaged across productions. Partner with the centralized crewing function to maintain visibility into crew availability, prevent scheduling conflicts, and ensure alignment with creative and editorial vision. Support rate structure consistency and market-competitive positioning across comparable roles. • On-Site Event Operations and Health & Safety: Oversee on-site event production operations, including venue logistics and coordination with league and arena broadcast groups. Ensure Health & Safety protocols and risk management standards are maintained across all production environments. Work with vendors and internal teams to identify and mitigate operational risks in advance of air, and maintain contingency plans for live production scenarios. • Labor and Workforce Compliance: Navigate both union and non-union production environments. Ensure third-party PSPs adhere to all applicable labor regulations and collective bargaining agreements. Work closely with Amazon's internal legal and labor teams to stay current on regulatory requirements, workforce compliance standards, and crew classification guidelines across domestic and international markets. Advise on compliance considerations as they arise, including jurisdictional rules and engagement terms. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Amazon teams including Editorial Production, Technical Operations, Business Development, Production Finance, Accounting, and Legal to operationalize properties and drive synergy. Align regularly with production teams across regions to share best practices and integrate new learnings. Support the Global Head of Production Ops in implementing operational strategy across all Prime Video Live Sports properties. • Escalation and Risk Management: Proactively identify issues and blockers, providing timely solutions to resolve them. Exercise sound judgment in issue spotting and decision making, escalating to senior leadership when matters carry risk or require broader organizational alignment. Lead regular status updates on project timelines, budgets, and production readiness. • Operational Process Improvement and Scalability: Seek continuous improvements in execution of existing productions. Recommend changes to operational strategy, seek alignment with stakeholders, and implement at regular intervals. Own and leverage internal production management tools to maintain full visibility into productions, track resource deployment, and surface issues. Contribute to frameworks, SOPs, and systems that enable the team to scale with increasing property volume and complexity. About the team The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to Prime Video customers worldwide. We drive production excellence through purpose-built processes and scalable operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand.
